39	def init_db():
40	    with get_db() as conn:
41	        conn.executescript("""
42	            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
43	                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
44	                username TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
45	                password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
46	                role TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user',
47	                email TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
48	                created_at TEXT NOT NULL
49	            );
50	            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tasks (
51	                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
52	                owner_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
53	                name TEXT NOT NULL,
54	                description TEXT DEFAULT '',
55	                status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
56	                created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
57	                FOREIGN KEY (owner_id) REFERENCES users(id)
58	            );
59	        """)
60	    _migrate_legacy_schema()
61	    _migrate_add_columns()

64	def _migrate_legacy_schema():
65	    """Migrate pre-JWT installs: rename items -> tasks, user_id -> owner_id,
66	    drop the now-unused stateless-auth tokens table. Safe to run repeatedly
67	    and never drops user or task rows."""
68	    with get_db() as conn:
69	        tables = {
70	            row["name"]
71	            for row in conn.execute(
72	                "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'"
73	            ).fetchall()
74	        }
75	
76	        if "items" in tables:
77	            item_cols = {row["name"] for row in conn.execute("PRAGMA table_info(items)").fetchall()}
78	            owner_col = "owner_id" if "owner_id" in item_cols else "user_id"
79	            conn.execute(
80	                f"INSERT INTO tasks (id, owner_id, name, description, created_at) "
81	                f"SELECT id, {owner_col}, name, description, created_at FROM items "
82	                f"WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM tasks)"
83	            )
84	            conn.execute("DROP TABLE items")
85	
86	        if "tokens" in tables:
87	            conn.execute("DROP TABLE tokens")
88	
89	        conn.commit()

92	def _migrate_add_columns():
93	    """Add columns introduced after the initial schema (email, status) to
94	    pre-existing databases. Safe to run repeatedly."""
95	    with get_db() as conn:
96	        user_cols = {row["name"] for row in conn.execute("PRAGMA table_info(users)").fetchall()}
97	        if "email" not in user_cols:
98	            conn.execute("ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN email TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''")
99	            conn.execute("UPDATE users SET email = username || '@example.com' WHERE email = ''")
100	
101	        task_cols = {row["name"] for row in conn.execute("PRAGMA table_info(tasks)").fetchall()}
102	        if "status" not in task_cols:

110	def hash_password(password: str) -> str:
111	    return generate_password_hash(password)
112	
113	
114	def _is_legacy_hash(password_hash: str) -> bool:
115	    # Legacy scheme: sha256("static_salt_1234:" + password) -> 64 hex chars
116	    return len(password_hash) == 64 and all(c in "0123456789abcdef" for c in password_hash)
117	
118	
119	def verify_password(password: str, password_hash: str) -> bool:
120	    if _is_legacy_hash(password_hash):
121	        salt = "static_salt_1234"
122	        return hashlib.sha256(f"{salt}:{password}".encode()).hexdigest() == password_hash
123	    return check_password_hash(password_hash, password)

126	def create_token(user_id: int, username: str) -> str:
127	    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
128	    payload = {
129	        "sub": str(user_id),
130	        "username": username,
131	        "iat": now,
132	        "exp": now + timedelta(seconds=TOKEN_TTL),
133	    }
134	    return jwt.encode(payload, app.config["SECRET_KEY"], algorithm=JWT_ALGORITHM)
135	
136	
137	def get_user_from_token(token: str) -> dict | None:
138	    try:
139	        payload = jwt.decode(token, app.config["SECRET_KEY"], algorithms=[JWT_ALGORITHM])
140	        user_id = int(payload["sub"])
141	    except (jwt.PyJWTError, KeyError, ValueError, TypeError):
142	        return None
143	    with get_db() as conn:
144	        row = conn.execute(
145	            "SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?", (user_id,)
146	        ).fetchone()
147	    return dict(row) if row else None

150	def require_auth(f):
151	    @wraps(f)
152	    def decorated(*args, **kwargs):
153	        auth = request.headers.get("Authorization", "")
154	        if not auth.startswith("Bearer "):
155	            return jsonify({"error": "missing authorization header"}), 401
156	        token = auth.split(" ", 1)[1]
157	        user = get_user_from_token(token)
158	        if user is None:
159	            return jsonify({"error": "invalid or expired token"}), 401
160	        return f(user, *args, **kwargs)
161	    return decorated

172	    username = data.get("username", "").strip()

175	    if not username or not password:

177	    if len(password) < 8:

185	        now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
186	        conn.execute(

188	            "VALUES (?, ?, 'user', ?, ?)",

195	@auth_bp.route("/login", methods=["POST"])
196	def login():
197	    data = request.get_json(silent=True) or {}
198	    username = data.get("username", "").strip()
199	    password = data.get("password", "")
200	    if not username or not password:
201	        return jsonify({"error": "username and password required"}), 400
202	    with get_db() as conn:
203	        row = conn.execute(
204	            "SELECT * FROM users WHERE username = ?", (username,)
205	        ).fetchone()
206	        user = None
207	        if row is not None and verify_password(password, row["password_hash"]):
208	            user = dict(row)
209	            if _is_legacy_hash(row["password_hash"]):
210	                # Lazily upgrade legacy sha256 hashes to werkzeug's scheme on successful login.
211	                conn.execute(
212	                    "UPDATE users SET password_hash = ? WHERE id = ?",
213	                    (hash_password(password), user["id"]),
214	                )
215	                conn.commit()
216	    if user is None:
217	        return jsonify({"error": "invalid credentials"}), 401
218	    token = create_token(user["id"], user["username"])
219	    return jsonify({"token": token, "username": user["username"], "role": user["role"]})
